semantics.publisher_rule: Repository publication binds package to an explicit authorized publisher identity.
semantics.identity_rule: UserModule canonical identity/version is distinct from repository path.
semantics.hash_rule: Fetched package hash is validated before install/load.
semantics.certification_rule: Certification is separate and may be required by policy but is not implied by repository presence.
semantics.inert_rule: Fetched module remains inert until normal install/load/enable lifecycle.
semantics.export_rule: Repository retrieval/export must preserve package bytes where byte-identical export is claimed.
semantics.authority_rule: Repository presence does not grant runtime authority.

invariants.rule: Packaging, hashing, certification and repository distribution preserve canonical semantics but do not become semantic or runtime authority.
